_doc: DERIVED, not authored. Event kind read from the event TITLE by tools/classify-events.mjs; regenerate rather than hand-edit. This reads what each record says about itself, unlike date extraction from the canon prose, which was attempted and abandoned because the year on a line usually belongs to a different event. Conservative on purpose: a title too vague to classify becomes "unclassified" rather than a guess, because a mislabelled event draws crossed swords over a peace treaty while an unclassified one simply does not appear on a themed layer.
